title: Carries and borrows
description:
Use the carry flag, through `adc` and `sbb`, with **no jumps**:

| Function | Result |
|---|---|
| `carry_out(a, b)` | 1 if the unsigned 64-bit sum a + b wraps around, else 0 |
| `add128_high(a_low, a_high, b_low, b_high)` | the high 64 bits of the 128-bit sum (a_high:a_low) + (b_high:b_low) |
| `below(a, b)` | 1 if a < b as **unsigned** numbers, else 0 |
| `sum_with_carry(a, b)` | a + b, plus 1 more if a + b wrapped: `sum_with_carry(-1, 1)` is 1 |

The four arguments of `add128_high` arrive in `rdi`, `rsi`, `rdx` and `rcx`.

starter.solution.asm:
carry_out:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

add128_high:
        mov     rax, rsi
        add     rax, rcx
        ret

below:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

sum_with_carry:
        mov     rax, rdi
        add     rax, rsi
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
carry_out:
        xor     eax, eax
        add     rdi, rsi                ; CF = the carry
        adc     eax, 0                  ; eax = 0 + 0 + CF
        ret

add128_high:
        mov     rax, rsi
        add     rdi, rdx                ; the low halves, setting CF
        adc     rax, rcx                ; the high halves plus the carry
        ret

below:
        xor     eax, eax
        cmp     rdi, rsi                ; CF = 1 when rdi < rsi (unsigned)
        sbb     rax, rax                ; rax = -CF: -1 or 0
        neg     rax                     ; 1 or 0
        ret

sum_with_carry:
        mov     rax, rdi
        add     rax, rsi
        adc     rax, 0
        ret

hints: `sum_with_carry(-1, -1)`: −1 + −1 wraps to −2 with a carry, and −2 + 1 is −1. This "end-around carry" is how the Internet's checksum adds numbers.
rules: No jumps: use the carry flag with adc and sbb.
unitTests:
test "carry out of an addition"
    carry_out(1, 2) == 0
    carry_out(-1, 1) == 1
    carry_out(0x8000000000000000, 0x8000000000000000) == 1
    carry_out(0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) == 0
test "128-bit addition"
    add128_high(1, 0, 2, 0) == 0
    add128_high(-1, 0, 1, 0) == 1
    add128_high(-1, 5, -1, 6) == 12
test "unsigned below"
    below(3, 5) == 1
    below(5, 3) == 0
    below(4, 4) == 0
    below(1, -1) == 1
    below(-1, 1) == 0
test "end-around carry"
    sum_with_carry(2, 3) == 5
    sum_with_carry(-1, 1) == 1
    sum_with_carry(-1, -1) == -1
